1.t: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people ˹saying to him˺, “Warn your people before a painful punishment comes to them.”
1.tr: Innaaa arsalnaa Noohan ilaa qawmihee an anzir qawmaka min qabli any yaatiyahum 'azaabun aleem

2.t: Noah proclaimed, “O my people! I am truly sent to you with a clear warning
2.tr: Qaala yaa-qawmi innee lakum nazeerum mubeen

3.t: worship Allah ˹alone˺, fear Him, and obey me

4.t: He will forgive your sins, and delay your end until the appointed time. Indeed, when the time set by Allah comes, it cannot be delayed, if only you knew!”
4.tr: Yaghfir lakum min zunoobikum Wa-yu'akhkhirkum ilaaa ajalim musammaa; innaa ajalal laahi izaa jaaa'a laa yu'akhkhar; law kuntum ta'lamoon

5.t: He cried, “My Lord! I have surely called my people day and night
5.tr: Qaala rabbi innee da'awtu qawmee lailanw Wa-naharaa

6.t: but my calls only made them run farther away

7.t: And whenever I invite them to be forgiven by You, they press their fingers into their ears, cover themselves with their clothes, persist ˹in denial˺, and act very arrogantly
7.tr: Wa-inee kullamaa da'awtuhum litaghfira lahum ja'alooo asaabi'ahum fee aazaanihim wastaghshaw siyaabahum Wa-asarroo wastakbarus tikbaaraa

8.t: Then I certainly called them openly

9.t: then I surely preached to them publicly and privately
9.tr: Summaa inneee a'lantu lahum Wa-asrartu lahum israaraa

10.t: saying, ‘Seek your Lord’s forgiveness, ˹for˺ He is truly Most Forgiving
10.tr: Faqultus taghfiroo Rabakum innahoo kaana Ghaffaaraa

11.t: He will shower you with abundant rain

12.t: supply you with wealth and children, and give you gardens as well as rivers
12.tr: Wa-yumdidkum bi-am-waalinw Wa-baneena Wa-yaj'al lakum Jannaatinw Wa-yaj'al lakum anhaaraa

13.t: What is the matter with you that you are not in awe of the Majesty of Allah
13.tr: Maa lakum laa tarjoona lillaahi waqaaraa

14.t: when He truly created you in stages ˹of development˺

15.t: Do you not see how Allah created seven heavens, one above the other
15.tr: Alam taraw kaifa khalaqal laahu sab'a samaawaatin tibaaqaa

16.t: placing the moon within them as a ˹reflected˺ light, and the sun as a ˹radiant˺ lamp
16.tr: Wa-ja'alal qamara feehinna nooranw Wa-ja'alash shamsa siraajaa

17.t: Allah ˹alone˺ caused you to grow from the earth like a plant

18.t: Then He will return you to it, and then simply bring you forth ˹again˺

19.t: And Allah ˹alone˺ spread out the earth for you

20.t: to walk along its spacious pathways.’”

21.t: ˹Eventually,˺ Noah cried, “My Lord! They have certainly persisted in disobeying me, and followed ˹instead˺ those ˹elite˺ whose ˹abundant˺ wealth and children only increase them in loss
21.tr: Qaala Noohur Rabbi innahum 'asawnee wattaba'oo mal lam yazid-hu maaluhoo Wa-waladuhooo illaa khasaara

22.t: and who have devised a tremendous plot

23.t: urging ˹their followers˺, ‘Do not abandon your idols—especially Wadd, Suwâ’, Yaghûth, Ya’ûq, and Nasr.’
23.tr: Wa-qaaloo laa tazarunna aalihatakum Wa-laa tazarunna Waddanw Wa-laa Suwaa'anw Wa-laa Yaghoosa Wa-Ya'ooqa Wa-Nasraa

24.t: Those ˹elite˺ have already led many astray. So ˹O Lord˺, only allow the wrongdoers to stray farther away.”
24.tr: Wa-qad adalloo kasee-ranw Wa-laa tazidiz zaalimeena illaa dalaalaa

25.t: So because of their sins, they were drowned, then admitted into the Fire. And they found none to help them against Allah
25.tr: Mimmaa khateee'-aatihim ughriqoo fa-udkhiloo Naaran falam yajidoo lahum min doonil laahi ansaaraa

26.t: Noah had prayed, “My Lord! Do not leave a single disbeliever on earth
26.tr: Wa-qaala Noohur Rabbi laa tazar 'alal ardi minal kaafireena daiyaaraa

27.t: For if You spare ˹any of˺ them, they will certainly mislead Your servants, and give birth only to ˹wicked˺ sinners, staunch disbelievers
27.tr: Innaka in tazarhum yudil-loo 'ibaadaka Wa-laa yalidooo illaa faajiran kaffaaraa

28.t: My Lord! Forgive me, my parents, and whoever enters my house in faith, and ˹all˺ believing men and women. And increase the wrongdoers only in destruction.”
28.tr: Rabbigh fir lee Wa-liwaa-lidaiya Wa-liman dakhala baitiya mu'minanw Wa-lil-mu'mineena wal-mu'minaati Wa-laa tazidiz zaalimeena illaa tabaaraa
